direction: Refine the single evolvable hook `score_ruin_nodes` toward stagnation-adaptive multiplicative gating: keep the proven multiplicative gate structure (|removal_savings|/scale * gate_load * gate_depot * gate_demand * gate_rdist) but make the rank-power exponent p a monotone function of (iter_frac, stagnation_ratio) so that early iterations favour high-savings worst-removal while late/stagnant iterations shift to spatially-related (Shaw-like) diversified removal; additionally tighten the capacity gate toward routes with high utilization (`route_loads/capacity -> 1`) and up-weight depot-proximal savings for eccentric-depot instances, since the archive's weakest regimes are capacity_level=tight, size=100, depot_style=eccentric.

operations.mechanism: Archive shows three L3 solvers within 0.47% of each other (16.0496/16.0512/16.1391) and only 0.478% above VBS, so gains must come from distribution-shifting the ruin selection rather than from skeleton changes; the weakest regimes (tight capacity 22.5%, size-100 21.2%, eccentric depot 20.3%, uniform demand 20.9% rel gap) are exactly those where a static worst-cost removal rule over-samples already-good routes. KB entry method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 documents that the evolved multiplicative gate + rank-power rule beats the zero-evolution Worst-Cost Removal control (23.3186 vs 23.3474 on blind_120, 20.6947 on select_64) and explicitly lists 'stagnation_aware_diversification' as the strong regime, and flags multi-generation fine-tuning of the dynamics as the open item — which is what this round targets. Relatedness-based destruction (method-cvrp-lns-shaw-regret) provides the diversification half, while the recreate side stays deterministic Regret-2 (method-cvrp-cheapest-regret-insertion) so the interface signature and the 6-customer dual-action causality probe (first_ruin_set A={1,2,3,4} / B={3,4,5,6}) remain valid under the 2000 ms budget where first_feasible_ms is only ~2-3 ms.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: H4: In `cvrp_ruin_recreate` (L3, Regret-2 recreate fixed, budget 2000 ms), an evolved `score_ruin_nodes` that (a) interpolates the rank-power exponent p from a low value (p~0.5, savings-dominated worst removal) at iter_frac<0.3 to a higher value (p~2) when stagnation_ratio>0.6 with a relatedness/reroute term, and (b) multiplies an extra capacity-saturation gate `exp(beta*(route_load/capacity))` with beta>0, will reduce mean objective on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 vs the current SBS mean 16.0496, with the largest per-instance gains concentrated in the capacity_level=tight and depot_style=eccentric subsets (>=1.0% improvement there) without regressing the clustered/spatial subset by more than 0.5%.
